items.title: Gucci hand-paints Fall/Winter mural on Shanghai shikumen
items.summary: Gucci unveiled a hand-painted mural of its Fall/Winter campaign on a shikumen building at Fengshengli in Shanghai's Jing'an district, part of the brand's long-running Art Wall project (now five cities: New York, Milan, London, Hong Kong, Shanghai). Activation coverage, discounted as brand-generated marketing rather than independent opinion.

items.title: Gucci names Park Bo-gum global brand ambassador
items.summary: Gucci appointed South Korean actor Park Bo-gum as global brand ambassador on November 5, citing his versatility and personal style. He previously wore Gucci hosting the Baeksang Arts Awards and on a W Korea cover; he also holds an Omega ambassadorship. Included as context for ambassador-driven buzz; discounted as activation/PR rather than independent public opinion.

items.title: 구찌 가방 95만원 내렸다...콧대 높던 명품업계에 무슨 일이
items.summary: Gucci cut the Mercato small tote in Korea from 4.45M to 3.5M won (-21.3%), its first markdown of this scale in over a decade; Boucheron and Van Cleef & Arpels followed with smaller cuts (up to 11% and ~4%). Kering CEO Luca de Meo said pricing had materially hurt volumes; Burberry's Joshua Schulman said consumers were fatigued by unreasonable luxury prices. Framed as Korea's biggest luxury markdown wave since Chanel's 2015 cuts.

items.title: [럭셔리월드]콧대 높던 명품도 무릎 꿇나…가격 내리는 구찌 vs 버티는 루이비통
items.summary: Contrasts Gucci's aggressive price cuts (Korean tote -950,000 won; European prices down up to 30%) amid 13 straight quarters of declining sales against LVMH's refusal to cut prices, with LVMH's CFO calling price cuts 'not a desirable choice' that risks brand appeal. Notes the global luxury buyer base shrank from 400M (2022) to 315M (2026), down 85M, even as overall market value rose slightly on wealth concentration.

items.title: 불황 속 구찌는 가방값 30% 내렸는데…루이비통은 망설이는 '명품의 금기'
items.summary: Covers Gucci breaking the long-standing luxury taboo against price cuts, lowering bag prices by up to 30% in Europe amid prolonged recession-driven demand weakness, while rival Louis Vuitton hesitates, fearing erosion of brand cachet. Frames Gucci's move as a structural first for the industry in roughly a decade.

items.title: "명품 살 돈이 없어요"…중산층 발길 끊기자 루이비통·구찌에 닥친 위기[나우,어스]
items.summary: Reports middle-class shoppers pulling back from Louis Vuitton and Gucci as living costs rise, forcing both brands into crisis-mode responses; frames Gucci's price cuts as a defensive move to retain a shrinking customer base rather than a confident strategic pivot.

items.title: "가격 인상은 공식이었는데" 구찌·부쉐론 잇단 인하…명품 '콧대' 꺾였나
items.summary: Analysis piece arguing that annual price increases had become an unwritten rule across luxury, and that Gucci's and Boucheron's recent cuts signal the industry's pricing power has visibly weakened after years of outpacing inflation.

items.title: "사자마자 130만원 떨어졌어요"⋯명품값 인하에 기존 구매자들 '허탈'
items.summary: Covers backlash from recent Gucci/luxury buyers who feel cheated after prices dropped shortly after their purchase, with one case citing a 1.3M won loss in perceived value; captures a genuine consumer-side grievance distinct from brand messaging.

items.title: Why discounts, store closures may not be enough for Gucci as China's luxury slowdown bites
items.summary: Critical analysis arguing Gucci's price cuts and store closures (including a Jinan MixC location shut in late October after 2.5 years) may not reverse the brand's China slide. Kering CFO Armelle Poulou is quoted calling mainland China the 'major headwind' as consumer confidence stays subdued and shoppers grow more selective; Kering targets roughly 125+ net store closures globally in 2026 and about 100 in China.

items.title: 古驰再闭店 高端消费品越来越难了？
items.summary: Chinese business-media piece on Gucci's continued store closures (Shanghai Raffles City and New World Daimaru boutiques shut, Shanghai count down to 7 stores) and a Bicester Village outlet closing, framed within a broader 'high-end consumption is getting harder' narrative covering weak China demand and brand-transition friction under Demna.

items.title: 古驰再闭店，高端消费品越来越难了？
items.summary: Syndicated/related coverage of Gucci's renewed China store closures, citing weak footfall, brand-image fade and insufficient product innovation as structural problems; cites quality-control data showing Gucci China returns tied to hardware oxidation/leather cracking rose from 8% (2019) to 23% (2023), a concrete quality-complaint data point.

items.title: [단독] 불황에 장사없다 … 구찌, 국내 매장 20% 철수 검토
items.summary: Reports Gucci Korea closing 25 regular department-store boutiques and 11 outlet stores, and reviewing withdrawal from roughly 10 more of its 46 remaining domestic stores; also notes Gucci notified Galleria Gwangyo of its planned exit. Framed within Kering's global pledge to shut 100+ additional stores in 2026.

items.title: 구찌와 머라이어 캐리가 완성한 눈부신 2026 홀리데이 풍경
items.summary: Covers Gucci's 2026 holiday gift campaign starring Mariah Carey, directed by Harmony Korine, set in a Christmas-decorated hotel and scored to 'All I Want for Christmas Is You'; introduces the new Butterfly Special Collection (available online Nov 2, in select stores from mid-November). Pure activation/campaign coverage, discounted as brand marketing rather than independent public opinion.

items.title: 57살 머라이어 캐리, 올해는 크리스마스 '쌍끌이'…'연금송'에 월드투어+명품 캠페인까지
items.summary: Entertainment-desk coverage noting Mariah Carey's double Christmas moment this year -- her perennial hit's seasonal resurgence plus a world tour -- alongside her new Gucci holiday campaign; mostly celebrity-news framing with Gucci as a secondary mention.

items.title: [ GUCCI X MARIAH CAREY ] Gucci Gift 2026 Holiday Campaign
items.summary: Official Gucci YouTube upload of the Mariah Carey holiday campaign film. Could not retrieve view/like/comment counts via available tools (page returned only navigation chrome, no metadata). Logged as a channel-mix sns item but engagement fields left null since not independently observed.

items.title: 古驰最近有什么大新闻？Demna首秀、关店105家、业绩承压，3个维度说清+FAQ
items.summary: One of a large cluster of near-identical templated Weibo 'explainer/FAQ' posts (dozens of near-duplicate titles found swapping store-closure/discount numbers) summarizing Gucci's Demna debut, ~105 store closures and earnings pressure. Pattern strongly resembles SEO/affiliate bot content rather than organic discussion; flagged as low-trust per bot-filter policy and admitted only as a volume/topic signal, not as genuine sentiment.

items.title: [취재썰] '12만원 구찌 가방' 들고 명품 수선집 가보니
items.summary: Korean community (theqoo) thread discussing a reporter-style investigation bringing a counterfeit 'Gucci bag that cost 120,000 won' to a luxury repair shop, with commenters discussing counterfeit quality and the gap between fake and real Gucci craftsmanship. Reflects ongoing counterfeit-market chatter rather than brand sentiment directly, included as community signal.

items.title: 구찌 시계 장단점(인증) - 시계 갤러리
items.summary: DC Inside watch-gallery community post weighing Gucci watch pros/cons, concluding strong brand recognition but noting finishing and movement quality lag behind other brands at similar price points -- a mild quality-perception critique from an ordinary consumer community thread.

items.title: 콧대 꺾인 명품…중산층 지갑 닫자 '가격 백기' By EBN
items.summary: Financial-wire syndication (EBN via Investing.com Korea) summarizing the luxury-wide price-cut trend led by Gucci and Boucheron, framed as the industry 'waving a white flag' on pricing after middle-class demand collapsed; positions Gucci as the sector's most visible price-cutter.

items.title: デムナの「グッチ」はどうだった？
items.summary: WWD Japan retrospective/analysis piece revisiting critical and audience reception of Demna's tenure at Gucci so far, continuing the publication's running 'pros and cons' coverage (prior installments scored the debut collection and noted polarized consumer reaction, dystopian-aesthetic concerns, and strong topicality but mixed substance).
